meta.name: business-case
meta.description: Develop a business case for an initiative using costs, benefits, risks and evidence. Use when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一项计划的成本、收益与风险整理成能说服赞助方的商业论证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在评审会上为一项计划争取经费或排期,却还没讲清投入产出。
copy.tagline_en: Turn an initiative's costs, benefits, and risks into a clear case sponsors will back.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must justify budget or timeline for an initiative to a sponsor.

howto.what: Claude 会为一项计划撰写商业论证,涵盖成本、收益、风险与证据,产出可供赞助人申请预算或时间线依据的材料。
howto.when: 当发起人需要预算或时间线依据时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的净化数据包与范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目写一份商业论证,包含成本、收益和风险
say.note: 先读任务上下文契约与方法文档,再动手

say.text: 这个计划要向赞助人申请预算,帮我整理论证材料
say.note: 产出面向赞助人的预算依据

say.text: 沿用当前范围,把风险和证据补进商业论证里
say.note: 按任务上下文契约控制权限与留存

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude develops a business case for an initiative — costs, benefits, risks and evidence — producing material a sponsor can use for budget or timeline justification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that run's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting.

say_en.text: Write a business case for this project, covering costs, benefits and risks
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first

say_en.text: This initiative needs sponsor budget approval — put the case together
say_en.note: Produces budget justification for a sponsor

say_en.text: Keep the current scope and add risks and evidence to the case
say_en.note: Persistence and authority follow the context contract
